description.value: El Cafecito is the daytime café concept within Alimentaria Mexicana, an authentic Mexican restaurant and cultural gathering place on Granville Island, directly across from the main public market entrance. The broader establishment celebrates Mexican culinary traditions through housemade heirloom corn chips, chilaquiles, birria, and an extensive mezcal and tequila program. Regular spirits workshops and taco omakase events make this a destination rather than just a pit stop.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (100 spaces) at 33m. Total: 100 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms El Cafecito is the morning café concept within the larger Alimentaria Mexicana restaurant at 1596 Johnston St., Granville Island, Vancouver. Multiple menu items are explicitly labeled '(VEGAN)' confirming vegetarian/vegan options, and an 'Order online' button confirms takeout availability. No evidence appears on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other amenities, so those are marked null. Two different phone numbers appear across the website (footer: +1(778)6528106; contact page: +1 236 521 8438), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Two different phone numbers appear on the website: the contact page lists +1 236 521 8438 while the footer on the events, about, and other pages consistently shows +1(778)6528106. The contact page number has been used as the primary value, but this discrepancy should be verified.

OSM names this as a standalone café ('El Cafecito') but the website presents it as a daypart concept within the larger Alimentaria Mexicana restaurant — the cantina operates under the same roof. The OSM record may underrepresent the full scope of the venue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café on Granville Island with a confirmed website, full menu, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists exploring the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: El Cafecito (café) and the Cantina (full-service restaurant) are co-located at the same address under the Alimentaria Mexicana brand. OSM has tagged only the café component.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labeled '(VEGAN)': Golden Beet Ceviche, Greens con Pipián Verde, Soy Chorizo & Papas tacos. Additional vegetarian items (halloumi tostada, chilaquiles) are present
